name: training_01
description: Compatibility mission for the original student animation integration spec. The active N8RO setup uses the app's AstsimSchema JSON.GZ profiles; this file documents the same intent for reviewers expecting the starter-pack mission name.
notes: No torques, forces, or rigid-body dynamics are computed by the plugin.
Motion is produced by joint-angle overrides.
Center of Mass is estimated inside the plugin and used to bias the kinematic pose.
Contact is represented through a replaceable contact-state hook; the current N8RO SDK headers used here do not expose explicit foot-contact flags to AnimationModelInput.
